analysis_note: Paired quality uses a common complete labelled ticket set per question and comparison. Condition tables are unpaired descriptive summaries. Noise SE assumes independent repeated calls; five repeats are too few for strong inference.

numerical_consistency.metric_policy: Quality and actions use unchanged provider-reported values, including flagged answers. Derived scores are diagnostics only. No automatic normalization or correction.
